title: The Gravity of Sector Nine
author: Felix Crane
blurb: Tamsin Villalobos, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
